observations: The guard refused its own author. CONTRADICTED was first written with #165 AND #169, because bullet 1 credits WP-055 for #169. Bullet 5 writes its range as '#165 to #170', so #169 never appears literally there and is not an intersection. test_registered_contradictions_still_fail rejected the entry, which is exactly what asserting that a registered defect still fails is for.

Check A was nearly written against the issue each row cites (#35, #34, both closed). That would have needed the network, which #311 forbids in this suite, and it would also have been weaker: an issue can close wontfix or superseded while the published summary it names is untouched. The string is the claim; the issue is only who was asked to change it.

'ADR-001…012' reads like notation for a range and the first draft skipped it on that basis. docs/NEXT_STEPS.md literally contains 'ADR-001…020' today - the same notation with the number repaired - so the row's target was a real string, verified against the commit that added the row before relying on it. A guard that had treated it as shorthand would have passed on the defect it exists to catch.
assumptions: That SOURCE_RECONCILIATION's Deferred rows keep naming their target in backticks. The reader asserts at least one such row exists, so a format change fails loudly rather than silently reading nothing.

authority.scope_note: A new test module. No design, record or claim is edited, so this does not wait on #316.

stop_if: An entry is ADDED to STALE_ROWS or CONTRADICTED. A registry entry may only leave, when its defect is repaired; adding one quiets the guard with the defect it was built to catch.
The guard is made to read issue states. The suite has no network import and #311 exists to keep it so.
A registered entry is removed without the corresponding record actually being repaired.

declared_non_coverage: Issue states are not checked. That needs the network and belongs to #311's advisory reconciliation.
Ranges are read as their two literal endpoints. '#165 to #170' contributes #165 and #170 only.

Only SOURCE_RECONCILIATION's table and PLAN-001 section 14 are read. Other records may carry the same defect and are not covered; the sweep that found these two examined 65 lines across all tracked .md and .html and is recorded on #349.
